issues.on_page: Community service activities 2,100 (General Fund code 1800, p11)
issues.issue: Community service activities (code 1800) are community-service fees, not student activity receipts; the matching detail line uses detail_category 'other charges for services', so the receipt and detail categories disagree. Charges for services/fees looks closer

39,383 of this line comes from the Activities Fund (p25). The rule sends school activity fund receipts to Extracurricular Receipts, but the printed label says 'other', so 'other' is defensible. The same applies to detail[...] Activities Fund 'Other local receipts' 39,383

issues.on_page: Reclassifications: Instruction +415,914, State programs (207,894), Federal programs (773,020)
issues.issue: The net contra is filed entirely under Federal Programs, but the p8 reclassification also removes all State programs spending (207,894) and moves 415,914 into Instruction. Function totals in detail therefore won't tie to the statement's function lines. Arithmetic is right and the line is marked computed/review

The split assumes all of the 415,914 that the p8 reclassification moved into Instruction (from State/Federal programs, which include IDEA 6406/6408/6412) is regular instruction rather than special education. The arithmetic ties, but the allocation is an assumption
